title: DP World opens new warehouse in Johor, Malaysia
summary:
DP World has opened a new warehouse in Johor, Malaysia, as part of the continued expansion of its logistics network across Southeast Asia.

The Johor facility is the first of two warehouses planned for Malaysia, with one in Kuala Lumpur scheduled to open later this year. Situated within the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone, the 11,514m2 warehouse is intended to support contract logistics operations for customers in time-sensitive supply chains, while strengthening connectivity between Malaysia, Singapore and regional trade corridors.
